Act4-2#1.zh: 当夜，众人就在桃花村住下。转眼间已经到强盗约定的时刻了。
Act4-2#1.t: That night everyone stayed in Peach Blossom Village. Before long, the hour the bandit had set arrived.

Act4-2#4.zh: 嘘～小声点，听听看他们在讲些什么！
Act4-2#4.t: Shh, quiet! Let's hear what they're saying!

Act4-2#5.zh: 帽儿光光，今夜做个新郎；衣衫窄窄，今夜做个娇客！
Act4-2#5.t: Shiny hat on my head, tonight I'm to be wed; snug clothes on my back, tonight the groom's in the sack!

Act4-2#6.zh: 哇哈哈！我的夫人在哪里！

Act4-2#7.zh: 大王息怒，想必是怕羞不敢出来...
Act4-2#7.t: Calm yourself, Your Majesty. No doubt she's too shy to come out...

Act4-2#8.zh: 呵呵...今夜就要成亲还那么害羞；我喜欢！丈人不用引路，我亲自到闺房中抱出新娘！
Act4-2#8.t: Heh heh... marrying tonight and still so shy. I like that! No need to show me the way, father-in-law. I'll carry the bride out of her chamber myself!

Act4-2#9.zh: 娘子，娘子，你不来迎接我，我就来找你啦；你不要怕羞，我明日就要你当压寨夫人！
Act4-2#9.t: My lady, my lady, if you won't come to greet me, I'll come to you! Don't be shy. Tomorrow you'll be queen of my stronghold!

Act4-2#10.t: Ow! Why are you hitting your husband?!

Act4-2#11.t: That'll teach you who your wife is!

Act4-2#12.t: Mother! The bride has no hair!

Act4-2#15.zh: 桃花村，小霸王抢亲失败！
Act4-2#15.t: Peach Blossom Village: the Little King's wedding raid fails!
